name: Advanced form editing, publishing and presentation continuity
statement: Editing and publishing an authored form must not silently alter stable field identities or their answer meanings. Responsive layout preserves the user's headings, current section and usable controls; light and dark modes preserve legibility. Native target realizations preserve observable submit, validation, conditional, repeatable and response-export semantics rather than copying DOM machinery.
changePolicy: foundational for OpenForm Flow reference; owner acceptance required for authoritative policy
